traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: equal the dancing item's Constitution modifier + your Charisma modifier + five times your level in this class

traits.name: Endless Waltz
traits.desc: Immediately after the item makes a slam attack, it can take the Dodge action as a bonus action.

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.desc: The item is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

actions.name: Force-Empowered Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: your spell attack modifier to hit, reach 5 ft., one target you can see. Hit: 1d10 + your Charisma modifier force damage.
